title: Bistatic Position Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/Bistatic_Position_Estimator.md
text: Estimate targets positions using bistatic range and angle measurements, 6 inputs, 2 outputs; {Range Measurement} sets the range measurement type, {Enable known variance input} and {Output covariances of position estimates}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RngEst
ports.summary: Range measurement (meters) real-valued 1-by- K vector | real-valued J -by- L matrix

ports.name: AngEst
ports.summary: Angle-of-arrival estimate (degrees) real-valued 1-by- L row vector | real-valued 2-by- L matrix

ports.name: RngVar
ports.summary: Range variance (meters-squared) positive real-valued J -by- L matrix | positive real-valued length- K row vector

ports.name: AngVar
ports.summary: Angle variance (degrees-squared) real-valued 1-by- L row vector | real-valued 2-by- L matrix

ports.name: TxPos
ports.summary: Transmitting anchor positions (meters) real-valued Q -by- J matrix

ports.name: RxPos
ports.summary: Receiving anchor positions (meters) real-valued Q -by- L matrix

ports.name: TgtPosEst
ports.summary: Target position estimate (meters) real-valued Q -by-1 vector

ports.name: TgtPosCov
ports.summary: Estimated target position covariance (meters-squared) real-valued Q -by- Q matrix | real-valued Q -by- Q -by- K array

params.name: Range Measurement
params.values: Range measurement type Bistatic range (default) | Range sum

params.name: Enable known variance input
params.values: Enable known variance inputs on (default) | off

params.name: Output covariances of position estimates
params.values: Output covariances of position estimates off (default) | on
